svg.title: Green–teal breathing bloom — original artwork by LoVis and his mother
svg.desc: Original artwork coauthored by LoVis and his mother. Purple represents humans, teal represents AI, and green represents biomass. All 180 original cells keep the supplied green–teal image and its gradients. A gentle local breathing wave defaults to six seconds. Ring rhythm is within this artwork and does not indicate a live connection to other people. Reduced-motion preferences show the resting artwork.
